note: The cheapest loud win (brief 013 D; brief 018 §5): the reference loud with the Scout and Fixer holding fire until the final fight, so the guard's are the only traced shots. Its orders up to the walk to the car are c017's hand-tuned ticks, pinned by `at`, without c017's close on the café wall (the Scout and Tech stay in their cover: walking Vale, the Enforcer no longer fires, so they must keep the blocker in their line, and it is down 3.3 s into the fight). Board and go: once the blocker is down the whole cell boards and the car leaves with the officers still at their stands. Re-sited 2026-10-19 (Waymark, brief 023; Sky's door option (b)): the reference loud now holds fire the same way (the response unit passes the getaway car on its way to the west-face door, and a drawn weapon there starts the fight early), so this run's head is the reference's, composed rather than pinned (the c017 ticks no longer reach the cabinet in time), and nobody is downed, so the Tech no longer carries the Fixer: the whole cell boards once the blocker is down. It plays as the reference loud does; the fastest and cheapest loud is now the reference itself (no earlier shot is possible: the reroute lands at 2:04, the guard's next mark is 2:30).
